answer: Make correlated identities bleed stake. Each posts a bond that decays each close at a rate rising with how tightly its outputs, timing, and funding trace correlate with others. An honest uncorrelated agent barely decays and recovers its bond. A yarrow of clones under one operator shares timing and a funding inlet, so every bond erodes fast together; the sable audit publishes each score. Spreading thin still shows as shared provenance; acting truly independently needs separate behavior and money per alias. Cost scales with manufactured independence, not keys.
